value.subject: Preschool Swim start in January
value.body:
Hello,

I'm interested in enrolling my child in Preschool Swim, and I'd like to start in January. I see that your site currently offers starts on 2026-11-21 and 2026-11-28, as well as a waitlist for a start on 2027-01-09.

Would it be possible for my child to start in January instead of one of the earlier sessions? If a spot is available or the waitlist is the best route, could you let me know how to proceed?

Thank you very much for your help.
